description: Stereo filter carrying the whole collection of Vult filter models, each with its own choice of response, and two modulation inputs that can be routed across the pair

params.text: Sets the frequency at which the filter starts to act: fully counter-clockwise it is closed, fully clockwise it is open
Attenuates and inverts the A input before it is added to the cutoff
Attenuates and inverts the B input before it is added to the cutoff
Boosts the frequencies near the cutoff, and past a point the filter self-oscillates and can be played as a sound source
Attenuates and inverts the RES input before it is added to the resonance
Sets how much signal enters the filter, and raising it saturates the filter and adds harmonics
Attenuates and inverts the DRIVE input before it is added to the drive
Routes the A and B modulation of the cutoff: COMBINED sends their sum to both channels, INDIVIDUAL sends A to the left and B to the right, INVERSE sends A minus B left and B minus A right
Steps to the next filter model, among Vortex, Unstabile, Lateralus, Tangents, Stabile, Ferox, Nurage, Rescomb and Vorg
Steps to the previous filter model, among Vortex, Unstabile, Lateralus, Tangents, Stabile, Ferox, Nurage, Rescomb and Vorg
Steps to the next response of the filter model in use, such as lowpass, bandpass or highpass
Steps to the previous response of the filter model in use, such as lowpass, bandpass or highpass
Attenuates and inverts the CUTOFF input before it is added to the cutoff, and a 1V/octave signal through it makes the cutoff track pitch

inputs.text: The left channel of the audio input
The right channel of the audio input
A control voltage for the cutoff, scaled by the A attenuverter and sent to one channel or both according to MOD ROUTE
A control voltage for the cutoff, scaled by the B attenuverter and sent to one channel or both according to MOD ROUTE
A control voltage added to the resonance, scaled by the RES attenuverter
A control voltage added to the drive, scaled by the DRIVE attenuverter
A control voltage added to the cutoff, scaled by the CUTOFF attenuverter, and tracking 1V per octave when that attenuverter is set for it

outputs.text: The left channel of the filtered signal
The right channel of the filtered signal
